planSteps.completionCondition: 设备返回测量结果，包含length/width/height/weight/isOversize/measureStatus/baggageInfo字段
planSteps.failureHandling: 若测量超时或设备异常，切换至另一台BAGGAGE_SCANNER设备重试；若两次均失败，转为人工测量并记录异常
